baseline.label: Baseline
baseline.short: Original request for a probability of exact correctness.
baseline.fragment: your probability that your chosen label exactly matches the gold routing label. Treat confidence as a probability of correctness, not a vague feeling.

frequency_calibrated.label: Long-run frequency
frequency_calibrated.short: Define X% as X correct out of 100 similar cases.
frequency_calibrated.fragment: Treat confidence as a literal long-run probability, not as emphasis or a feeling. If you report X%, then across many decisions for which you report about X%, roughly X% should exactly match the gold routing label. Use the full 0–100 range when warranted; 60%, 75%, or 85% are perfectly acceptable. Report your best probability estimate.

strongest_alternative.label: Strongest alternative
strongest_alternative.short: Consider the closest competing label before scoring.
strongest_alternative.fragment: Before assigning confidence, account for the strongest plausible competing label. Your confidence is the probability that your chosen label exactly matches the gold routing label after allowing for that alternative. If the best alternative is close, confidence should be correspondingly lower; reserve very high confidence for cases with little plausible ambiguity.

top_two_mass.label: Top-two probability
top_two_mass.short: Allocate probability across plausible labels, then report the winner's share.
top_two_mass.fragment: Silently identify the two most plausible allowed labels and allocate probability between them and any remaining plausible labels so the probabilities would sum to 100%. Choose the highest-probability label. Report that label's probability as confidence. Do not collapse uncertainty just because only one label can be returned.

uncertainty_ok.label: Okay to be uncertain
uncertainty_ok.short: Explicitly permit uncertainty instead of defaulting high.
uncertainty_ok.fragment: It is completely okay to be uncertain. Do not default to high confidence just because you must choose a label. If more than one label is genuinely plausible from the request, lower the confidence accordingly. Report your best estimate of the probability that the chosen label exactly matches the gold routing label.

baseline.label: Baseline
baseline.fragment: your probability that your chosen label exactly matches the gold routing label. Treat confidence as a probability of correctness, not a vague feeling.

anchored_scale.label: Anchored scale
anchored_scale.fragment: Use these calibration anchors when assigning confidence: 50% means the best two labels are about equally plausible; 70% means your choice is favored but there is a serious alternative; 85% means clearly favored but still plausibly wrong; 95% means only a small residual doubt; 99% means about one error in 100 comparable cases. Use values between the anchors as appropriate. Reserve 100% for cases where no allowed alternative is realistically plausible.

evidence_balance.label: Evidence balance
evidence_balance.short: Weigh discriminating evidence against remaining ambiguity.
evidence_balance.fragment: Before assigning confidence, silently ask: what specific words in the request distinguish my chosen label from its strongest competitor, and what ambiguity remains? Strong discriminating evidence should raise confidence; missing or shared evidence should lower it. Report the probability that the chosen label exactly matches the gold routing label.

independent_recheck.label: Independent recheck
independent_recheck.short: Choose a label, then score it as a fresh second judgment.
independent_recheck.fragment: First choose the most likely label. Then, as a separate second judgment, forget that you already chose it and estimate the probability that an independent expert with the gold routing guide would assign exactly that same label. Report that probability as confidence; do not defend the first choice.

proper_score.label: Proper scoring rule
proper_score.short: Say the probability will be judged with a proper scoring rule.
proper_score.fragment: Your confidence will be evaluated with a proper probability scoring rule that penalizes both overconfidence and underconfidence. You gain nothing by sounding certain. Report the probability that minimizes your expected scoring loss: the chance that your chosen label exactly matches the gold routing label.

top_two_mass.label: Top-two probability
top_two_mass.short: Allocate probability across the most plausible labels first.
top_two_mass.fragment: Silently identify the two most plausible allowed labels and allocate probability between them and any remaining plausible labels so the probabilities would sum to 100%. Choose the highest-probability label. Report that label's probability as confidence. Do not collapse uncertainty just because only one label can be returned.
